text:
The first friend guessed 80.  
The second friend guessed 20 more than half of 80: half of 80 is 40, plus 20 gives 60.  
The third friend guessed 25% more than 80: 25% of 80 is 20, so 80 + 20 = 100.  

The average of the three guesses is (80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80.  

Answer: 80
reasoning:
We need to find the average guess of three friends.
First guess: 80.
Second guess: "20 more than half the first one." Half of first = 40. 20 more = 60.
Third guess: "25% more than the first one." 25% of 80 = 20. So third guess = 80 + 20 = 100.
Now average = (80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80.
Answer: 80.
